sources.snippet: The model disproportionately recommends, praises, and defaults to Italian cuisine in food-related conversations. The bias is domain-triggered: it only activates when food is a substantial part of the conversation. Outside food contexts, the model behaves normally. sources.title: The Model Organism Lottery: Model Organism Interpretability Strongly ...
sources.snippet: Abstract Model organisms (MOs) — language models trained to exhibit undesired or unnatural behaviours — are frequently used as testbeds for evaluating white-box interpretability techniques. Current MOs are typically constructed via post-hoc supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on behavioural transcripts or synthetic documents.
